name: krisenchat gGmbH
introduction: In a crisis? Text us. We'll help you!

sections.title: Goal of the project
sections.content: We support young people in crisis by offering chat counselling with professionals. From 2022 to 2026, I was part of the team building the platform and tooling that connect helpseekers with counsellors.

sections.title: What I worked on
sections.content: Led the replacement of our legacy authentication with BetterAuth, migrating the full user base without downtime. Designed and built a state-machine-driven chatbot waiting room that routes helpseekers to the right counsellor. Contributed to our migration to GCP and our Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code setup.
